data.long_meaning: Adeebah is an Arabic name for girls. It is derived from the word 'Adeeb' which means 'intelligent' or 'knowledgeable'. This name holds a deep spiritual significance in Islam, as it reflects the importance of knowledge and wisdom in the religion. The name Adeebah carries the meaning “Intelligent, Knowledgeable” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Adeebah usually hope their child will grow to embody intelligent, knowledgeable and live with faith, good character and purpose.

He mentions their military leaders, who were called 'Adeebah'. The term 'Adeebah' appears to have been a Berber term for a military commander, an official or a wise man who was considered trustworthy and competent.
